| Item | Amount | Energy |
|---|---|---|
| Orange juice | ~250 ml | ~110 kcal |
| Milk (full cream) | ~250 ml | ~160 kcal |
| Apple or pineapple juice | ~250 ml | ~115 kcal |
| Yogurt (Gippsland strawberry) | 150 g | ~150 kcal |
| Canned peaches | ~80 g | ~45 kcal |
| Cooked mushrooms | ~80 g | ~40 kcal |
| Strawberries | ~70 g | ~25 kcal |

That totals about 645 kcal served. I estimate about 65 kcal will be left over, mostly part of the juice or fruit, so about 580 kcal eaten.

- **Fat:** milk 9 g, yogurt 5 g, mushrooms (if cooked in oil) about 2 g, for about 16 g.
- **Carbohydrate:** about 92 g.
